{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 1 is the 57th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 1st day of Aquarius, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 9, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮1日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 57|Chapter 57]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152077}}.
